text: Right. Confession time. I used to be a terribly fussy eater.
Same brown pellets. Every. Single. Day.
Then one morning… something new turned up.
Real chicken. Fresh eggs. Veggies, berries… even sardines!
Now I wake up thinking about breakfast.
I sit by my bowl. I wait. Very nicely.
Right4Paws Ultimate Diet. Raw, made right.
